headline: Bumble Misses Q3 Revenue and Earnings Estimates
summary: Bumble reported third-quarter earnings and revenue that both fell short of analyst expectations.
why: Earnings reports provide key insights into a company's financial health, operational efficiency, and profitability, directly influencing investor sentiment and share price valuation.

impacts.name: Bumble
impacts.why: Missing quarterly revenue and earnings estimates typically weighs negatively on a company's share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
